new_libraries.name: Soga
new_libraries.author: Mzwandile Zulu, CMT Robotic Industries
new_libraries.sentence: Write Arduino sketches in isiZulu, isiXhosa, siSwati, isiNdebele, Sesotho, Setswana, Sepedi, Xitsonga, Tshivenda and Afrikaans.
new_libraries.paragraph: Add #include <isiZulu.h> (or your language) as the first line and write setup, loop, pinMode, digitalWrite, Serial, Servo, Stepper, LCD, DHT11, RFID, RTC, IR remote, keypad, MAX7219 and 7-segment code in your home language. Includes 26 starter-kit examples in every language.

library.name: ESP32_CAN_NG
library.author: TechOverflow, Collin Kidder, Outlandnish
library.sentence: CAN/CAN-FD library for ESP32 built-in TWAI controllers, IDF 4.x–6.1
library.paragraph: Supports classic CAN on all ESP32 variants and CAN-FD on ESP32-C5. Multi-controller support (ESP32-C6: 2x, ESP32-P4: 3x). Automatic IDF version detection across legacy, _v2 handle-based, and new esp_driver_twai APIs.

library.name: USBSnifferPIO_RP2040
library.author: Ângelo Moisés Alves
library.sentence: Passive USB 1.1 packet sniffer using the RP2040 PIO coprocessor.
library.paragraph: Captures Low-Speed (1.5 Mbps) and Full-Speed (12 Mbps) USB packets passively through high-impedance GPIO tapping. Uses a 22-instruction PIO hardware 8x DPLL for clock recovery, zero-gap 2-channel hardware DMA ping-pong buffering, and an SRAM-resident -O3 decoder implementing inline NRZI decoding, bit-unstuffing, packet framing, and table-accelerated CRC5/CRC16 verification. Delivers structured USBPacket objects through a callback API. Dual-core ready. Ideal for protocol analysis, HID device monitoring, and USB debugging.
